decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered the list for actual backpacks that would be suitable for hiking or travel. The SHENHU 40L (prod_backpacks_111) was a strong budget contender, but the KAILAS 28L (prod_backpacks_043) offered better technical features like a carbon fiber frame and a suspension system for ventilation. Reviews specifically compared the KAILAS to high-end Osprey packs, which suggests better long-term value than the SHENHU. The Granite Gear pack (prod_backpacks_041) was disqualified due to multiple reviews reporting broken shoulder straps. The TUDEQU sling and BASSDASH tackle bag were too specialized for general use. I decided to purchase the KAILAS 28L due to its build quality and comfort features.
